name: Dead Fools Club: 3v3
summary:
Welcome to the Dead Fools Club. The battlefield is a toy diorama on your real table, and your fighter is a little fool with a big gun.

• Press PLAY: a quick online match for up to 6 players.
• Squads: invite friends, play on one team and go into a match together.
• Four survivors of the club's first secret game: BURNS — shotgun, grenades over walls, heals the squad; SMITH — piercing sniper rifle and homing missiles; IRON — flamethrower and bazooka; BEANS — burst rifle, bombs, mines and smoke.
• Twelve boar
